method: Independent readback from Lean code and directly imported repository definitions; no compilation and no repository edits. Reference Lean source was read as code context. Filenames were not used to infer conclusions.
english_original_source_notice: Original-source quotations and verified bibliographic references remain pending addition by the lead agent. No quotation has been invented.
readback_scope: All declarations in proposed Definitions and Theorems, including named and anonymous mathematical instances. Reference-source declarations are not duplicated. Existing directly imported repository declarations are expanded only as context.

model_expansion.en: A specified Fermat model M of exponent N consists of an intermediate field K between ℚ and an algebraic closure of ℚ(X), elements u,v∈K with u transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. The readbacks quantify over supplied models and do not assert that a model exists.
model_expansion.zh_Hans: 指数为 N 的给定 Fermat 模型 M 包含有理数域与 ℚ(X) 的代数闭包之间的中间域 K，以及元素 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。读回量化的是已给定模型，不断言模型存在。
model_expansion.ja: 指数 N の指定された Fermat 模型 M は、有理数体と ℚ(X) の代数閉包との間の中間体 K、および元 u,v∈K からなり、u は有理数体上超越的であり、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K は ℚ(u) 上有限次元かつ [K:ℚ(u)]=N を満たす。読戻しは与えられた模型について量化し、模型の存在は主張しない。

notation.en: κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P; deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P); a divisor is a finite-support function P↦A(P)∈ℤ; its degree is Σ_P A(P)deg(P); effectiveness means A(P)≥0 for every P; pole multiplicity is max(0,−ord_P(f)), including f=0.
notation.zh_Hans: κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P；deg(P) 是剩余域在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩；除子是有限支撑整数值函数 P↦A(P)，其次数为 Σ_P A(P)deg(P)；有效指每处的系数非负；极点重数为 max(0,−ord_P(f))，也包括零函数。
notation.ja: κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P、deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) とする。因子は有限台の整数値関数 P↦A(P) であり、その次数は Σ_P A(P)deg(P) である。有効とは全ての係数が非負であることをいう。極の重複度は零関数も含め max(0,−ord_P(f)) である。

K.en: Let K be any field of characteristic zero.
K.zh: 设 K 为任意特征零域。
K.ja: K を任意の標数零の体とする。

KF.ja: K を任意の体とする。

KC.en: Let K be any field of characteristic zero that is finite over ℚ(t₀) for some t₀ transcendental over ℚ.
KC.zh: 设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限扩张。
KC.ja: K を標数零の任意の体とし、有理数体上超越的なある t₀ に対して K は ℚ(t₀) の有限拡大であるとする。

PC.en: Let K satisfy IsCurveField, and let P be any place of K, that is, a proper valuation subring O_P containing ℚ.
PC.zh: 设 K 满足曲线函数域条件，并令 P 为 K 的任意处，即包含有理数域的真赋值子环 O_P。
PC.ja: K は曲線関数体の条件を満たすとし、P を K の任意の素点、すなわち有理数体を含む真の付値部分環 O_P とする。

P.en: Let K be any field of characteristic zero and P any place, represented by its proper valuation subring O_P containing ℚ.
P.zh: 设 K 为任意特征零域，P 为任意处，其赋值环 O_P 是包含有理数域的真赋值子环。
P.ja: K を任意の標数零の体とし、P を有理数体を含む真の付値部分環 O_P で表される任意の素点とする。

PF.en: Let K be any field and P any place of K.
PF.zh: 设 K 为任意域，P 为 K 的任意处。
PF.ja: K を任意の体とし、P を K の任意の素点とする。

T.en: Let K satisfy IsCurveField and let t∈K be transcendental over ℚ. Write A_t for the integral closure of ℚ[t] in K.
T.zh: 设 K 满足曲线函数域条件，t∈K 关于有理数域超越，A_t 表示 ℚ[t] 在 K 中的整闭包。
T.ja: K は曲線関数体の条件を満たし、t∈K は有理数体上超越的であるとする。A_t を ℚ[t] の K における整閉包と書く。

R.en: Let K be a field, R a commutative ring, and ι:R→K its specified algebra map. Let O be a valuation subring of K containing ι(R).
R.zh: 设 K 为域，R 为交换环，ι:R→K 为给定代数映射，O 为包含 ι(R) 的 K 的赋值子环。
R.ja: K を体、R を可換環、ι:R→K を指定された代数の構造写像とし、O を ι(R) を含む K の付値部分環とする。

RF.en: Let R be an integral domain, K its specified fraction field, ι:R→K the algebra map, and O a proper valuation subring of K containing ι(R).
RF.zh: 设 R 为整环，K 为其给定分式域，ι:R→K 为代数映射，O 为包含 ι(R) 的 K 的真赋值子环。
RF.ja: R を整域、K を指定されたその分数体、ι:R→K を構造写像とし、O を ι(R) を含む K の真の付値部分環とする。

RD.en: Let R be a Dedekind domain, K its specified fraction field, and ι:R→K the algebra map.
RD.zh: 设 R 为 Dedekind 整环，K 为其给定分式域，ι:R→K 为代数映射。
RD.ja: R を Dedekind 整域、K を指定されたその分数体、ι:R→K を構造写像とする。

M.en: For every N∈ℕ and every specified Fermat model M of exponent N,
M.zh: 对任意自然数 N 及任意给定的指数为 N 的 Fermat 模型 M，
M.ja: 任意の自然数 N と指数 N の指定された任意の Fermat 模型 M に対して、

MD.en: For every N∈ℕ, every specified Fermat model M, and every proof hDVR that all places of M.K have discrete valuation rings, write L(A) for {f∈M.K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) at every place P}, and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A).
MD.zh: 对任意自然数 N、任意给定 Fermat 模型 M 以及其每个处的赋值环均为离散赋值环的证明 hDVR，记 L(A)={f∈M.K | f=0 或对每个处 P 都有 ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}，ℓ(A) 为 L(A) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩。
MD.ja: 任意の自然数 N、指定された任意の Fermat 模型 M、および全ての素点の付値環が離散付値環であることの任意の証明 hDVR を取る。L(A)={f∈M.K | f=0 または全ての素点 P で ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}、ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A) と書く。

readbacks.lean_signature: theorem transcendental_inv_iff {t : K} : Transcendental ℚ t⁻¹ ↔ Transcendental ℚ t
readbacks.en: Let K be any field of characteristic zero. For every t∈K, t⁻¹ is transcendental over ℚ if and only if t is.

readbacks.lean_signature: theorem exists_transcendental : ∃ t : K, Transcendental ℚ t
readbacks.en: Let K be any field of characteristic zero for which there exists t₀∈K transcendental over ℚ such that K is a finite-dimensional extension of ℚ(t₀). A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. There exists an element of K transcendental over ℚ.
readbacks.zh_Hans: 设 K 为任意特征零域，且存在关于有理数域超越的 t₀∈K，使 K 是 ℚ(t₀) 的有限维扩张。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。K 中存在关于有理数域超越的元素。
readbacks.ja: K を任意の標数零の体とし、有理数体上超越的な t₀∈K が存在して K は ℚ(t₀) 上有限次元であるとする。K の素点 P とは、全ての有理数の像を含み K に真に含まれる付値部分環 O_P をいう。𝔪_P をその極大イデアル、κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P を剰余体とし、剰余写像は商準同型 O_P→κ(P) を表す。O_P が離散付値環である素点では、ord_P(f) は f の正規化された整数値の位数を表し、極大イデアルの非零元では正、極では負となり、ord_P(0)=0 と定める。同値な表示は ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)) である。v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ は正規化された乗法的付値、ℤᵐ⁰ は整数の加法群を乗法的に書き零元を加えたものであり、log と exp はこの記法の形式的な写像であって実解析の関数ではない。K には有理数体上超越的な元が存在する。

readbacks.lean_signature: theorem model_placesDiscrete {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) : PlacesDiscrete M
readbacks.en: For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). def riemannRochSpace (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (A : Divisor M) : Submodule ℚ M.K
readbacks.en: For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). For every divisor A, riemannRochSpace M hDVR A is the ℚ-subspace L(A) defined above. A divisor is an integer-valued function of finite support on all places of M.K.
readbacks.zh_Hans: 对任意自然数 N 和任意给定模型 M，令 K=M.K 为有理数域与有理函数域 ℚ(X) 的一个固定代数闭包之间的中间域。模型给定 u,v∈K，满足 u 关于有理数域超越、u^N+v^N=1、ℚ(u,v)=K、K 在 ℚ(u) 上有限维且 [K:ℚ(u)]=N。K 的一个处 P 指包含所有有理数的像且真包含于 K 的赋值子环 O_P。记 𝔪_P 为其极大理想，κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P 为其剩余域，剩余映射指商同态 O_P→κ(P)。除子 A 指 K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数；除子不等式指每个处的系数不等式，若每个处 P 都满足 A(P)≥0，则称 A 有效。记 deg(P) 为剩余域 κ(P) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩，deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P)，其中剩余域次数先转为整数。自然数值有限秩在空间有限维时等于通常的向量空间维数。当处 P 的赋值环 O_P 为离散赋值环时，ord_P(f) 表示函数 f 的正规化整数阶，在极大理想的非零元素上为正、在极点处为负，并约定 ord_P(0)=0。等价地 ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f))，其中 v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ 为正规化乘法赋值，ℤᵐ⁰ 是整数加法群改写为乘法记法后再添零元的构造，log 与 exp 是该记法的形式映射，并非实数解析函数。另给定证明 hDVR，断言每个处 P 的赋值环 O_P 都是离散赋值环。对每个除子 A，定义有理数线性子空间 L(A)={f∈K | f=0 或每个处 P 都满足 ord_P(f)≥−A(P)}，并记 ℓ(A) 为 L(A) 在有理数域上的自然数值有限秩。对任意除子 A，riemannRochSpace M hDVR A 定义为上述有理数线性子空间 L(A)。这里除子是 M.K 的全部处上的有限支撑整数值函数。

theorem mem_riemannRochSpace (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (A : Divisor M) (f : M.K) :
    f ∈ riemannRochSpace M hDVR A ↔
      f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place M.K, -A P ≤ ord M hDVR P f
readbacks.en: For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Write (f), (f)₀ and (f)∞ for the finite-support divisors of coefficients ord_P(f), max(0,ord_P(f)) and max(0,−ord_P(f)), respectively; these are the principal divisor, zero divisor and pole divisor of f. By the order convention all three divisors of the zero function are the zero divisor whose coefficients are all zero. Write [P] for the divisor of coefficient one at P and zero elsewhere. For every divisor A and f∈M.K, f∈L(A) if and only if f=0 or, for every place P, −A(P)≤ord_P(f).

theorem polarPresentation_of_largeEffectivePolarRealization
    (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (hRealize : ∃ N1 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor M, 0 ≤ A → N1 ≤ divisorDegree M A →
      ∃ f : M.K, ∀ P : Place M.K, poleMultiplicity M hDVR f P = A P)

readbacks.en: For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). Write (f), (f)₀ and (f)∞ for the finite-support divisors of coefficients ord_P(f), max(0,ord_P(f)) and max(0,−ord_P(f)), respectively; these are the principal divisor, zero divisor and pole divisor of f. By the order convention all three divisors of the zero function are the zero divisor whose coefficients are all zero. Write [P] for the divisor of coefficient one at P and zero elsewhere. Assume there exists an integer N₁ such that every effective divisor A of degree at least N₁ is exactly realized by the pole multiplicities of some f∈M.K at all places. Then for every divisor D, there exist f,g∈M.K such that, for every place P, D(P)=max(0,−ord_P(f))−max(0,−ord_P(g)).

readbacks.en: For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). theorem riemannRochEventuallyLinear {N : ℕ} (M : Model N)
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) :
    ∃ g0 N0 : ℤ, ∀ A : Divisor M, N0 ≤ divisorDegree M A →

readbacks.en: For every natural number N and every given model M, let K=M.K be an intermediate field between ℚ and a fixed algebraic closure of the rational function field ℚ(X). The model supplies u,v∈K such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N+v^N=1, ℚ(u,v)=K, K is finite-dimensional over ℚ(u), and [K:ℚ(u)]=N. A place P of K is a valuation subring O_P properly contained in K and containing the image of every rational number. Write 𝔪_P for its maximal ideal, κ(P)=O_P/𝔪_P for its residue field, and the residue map for the quotient homomorphism O_P→κ(P). A divisor A is a function from all places of K to ℤ with finite support; inequalities between divisors mean inequalities of every coefficient, and A is effective if A(P)≥0 for every place P. Write deg(P)=Module.finrank_ℚ κ(P) and deg(A)=Σ_P A(P)deg(P), with the residue degrees cast to integers. Here Module.finrank is the natural-number-valued finite rank, which is the usual vector-space dimension when finite-dimensionality holds. For a place with discrete valuation ring O_P, ord_P(f) denotes the normalized integer order of f, positive on nonzero elements of 𝔪_P and negative on poles; its value at zero is defined to be ord_P(0)=0. Equivalently ord_P(f)=−log(v_P(f)), where v_P:K→ℤᵐ⁰ is the normalized multiplicative valuation, ℤᵐ⁰ is the multiplicative copy of ℤ with an added zero, and log and exp are the formal maps for this notation, not real analytic functions. Supply any proof hDVR that O_P is a discrete valuation ring for every place P of K. For each divisor A define the ℚ-subspace L(A)={f∈K | f=0 or ord_P(f)≥−A(P) for every place P} and ℓ(A)=Module.finrank_ℚ L(A). There exist integers g₀ and N₀, depending on the fixed M and hDVR, such that every divisor A with deg(A)≥N₀ satisfies the integer equality ℓ(A)=deg(A)−g₀. The divisor A need not be effective.

shape_questions_and_signature_boundaries.note: 这三条拟上传定理的源文件目前含 sorry；本次只读声明，不提供编译或公理审查结论。
riemannEll 是 Module.finrank，而非另行指定的亏格函数。上界与最终线性命题自身不接受有限维证明；组合定理另有对所有 A 的 hFinite 输入。不能把单独自然数值有限秩的使用读成已经证明有限维。
常数为实际 ℓ(0)，没有声明 ℓ(0)=1，也没有假定常数域恰为有理数域。
g₀,N₀ 都是整数，没有非负条件；存在量词位于对除子 A 的全称量词之前，所以两常数必须对固定模型的所有足够大次数除子统一适用。未将 g₀ 认定为几何亏格减一。
只在结论中要求 A 有效且次数达到同一个整数阈值；结论是全部处的极点重数逐点相等。签名不另要求输出函数非零，尽管证明内部构造了非零函数。
hRF 明确保留为参数，但该源证明项没有使用此参数。记录为签名边界，不据此判错。结论仅是 PolarPresentation 非空，不包括两个函数非零、唯一或可计算。
所有模型量化均为 N:ℕ，没有 N≥3 等额外假设；这些定理均以给定 Model N 为输入，不证明该类型非空。
ord_P(0)=0；后一个等价命题覆盖零元，原注释中的 nonzero 比签名窄。不得将零函数的通常无限阶约定代入。
该定义在一般整环及分式域上下文中只以素性和非零性构造 HeightOneSpectrum 元。盲读采用“非零素理想并封装为该类型”；若文案要在一般上下文声称 Krull 高度恰为一，仍须核对类型定义或补充假设。在 Dedekind 整环上下文可正常使用高度一素理想术语。
声明只编码关于某个超越元素的有理函数域的有限扩张；不额外将光滑、适当、几何连通模型或有理数域代数闭性作为已给定结构读入。
ℤᵐ⁰、log、exp 是乘法记法整数与添零构造的形式映射，不是实数对数、实数指数或绝对值。
英文原文引用及可核查文献定位仍待主代理补充；本文件没有将代码注释中的来源说明冒充论文原文引文。
